content: Pauli jujenda ku Yelusalemu
Hetwabia tutabukini nabu, twakwela sitima twajenda mbaka ku Kosi. Kilabu jaki bahika ku Lode, nukuhuma hoku twajenda ku Patala.
Hokuje, tujiketaniya sitima labiya lijenda ku Foinike, henu twakwela, twatumbuliya sapwali.
Patwahika ku Kupulo, tuguleka upandi wa mangegi twajenda ku Silia. Twajema musi uku Tilo papuje sitima lela labii lijenda kuhulu misigu.
Twaaketaniya na banafunzi kola, twatama pamu nabu masoba saba. Banafunzi bala balongila koni alongoswa na Loho jaka Sapanga, bumpwajila Pauli jwijenda ku Yelusalemu.
Lakini muda witu pagwajomuka twabokaniya nukuendale na sapwali, twaboti pamwa na aka mbomba na bana babu butuhindakiya mbaka kunza ja misi. Twahika kumbwani, twaboti twagungamaliya nukundoba Sapanga.
Ndienu twatabukana pamwa, twepani twakwela sitima nabombi babujaniya mwama nyumba gabu.
Twaendaliya na sapwali jitu kuhuma ku Tilo mbaka etwahika ku Tolemai, twaalamua banafunzi ba kola na twatama nabu lisoba limu.
Kilabu jaki twaboka twajenda ku Kaisalia. Hoku je twajenda kunyumba jaka mundu jojulandi lilobi laka Sapanga jobunkema Pilipi. Jombi jabii jumu ja bandu saba babahaguliwi ku Yelusalemu kola.
Pilipu jabii na bana baki aka kamwali nsesi bababii akabikila nabombi babii apia ulota.
Twatama kola masoba gingi, ndienu Mlota waka Sapanga jumu joakema Agabo jahika kuhuma ku Yudea.

Jutuhikila, jajukua nkanda waka Pauli lojukonge mukibunu, jilikonga mwamaboku na mwamagolu, jakapwaga, “Loho jaka Sapanga jipwaga ana, ‘Ayaudi buku Yelusalemu bankonga mundu jununkanda ago ana nukunkabisa kwa bandu bu ndema jengi.’ ”
Patajowana malobi gala, twepani na alongu bangi tundoba Pauli jwijenda ku Yelusalemu.
Lakini jombi jwajibwa, “Ntendaki kike, mpala lee kungelebu mojuwa kunyuma sukunelela? Ne mi tayali si kunyege nkati pena ila hata kuwa ku Yelusalemu ndaba jiliina laka Bambu Yesu.”
Pajakana kutujogwane twatama nuu, twapwaga, “Leejupala Bambu lihengikaje!”
Patajomula kutama pala kwa muda, twakonga misigu jitu, nukujenda ku Yelusalemu.

Apwasi bangi buku Kaisalia bajenda pamu na twepani, butupelika kunyumba jaka Mnasoni kotwajenda kutamani masoba kidogu. Mnasoni jwabi mundu juku Kupulo kabee jwabi anzetaki Sapanga masoba gingi gagapeta.
Pauli jujenda kundamuki Yakobu
Patwaika ku Yelusalemu, bandu baanzetake Sapanga butujopiki sapi ngamaa.
Kilabu jaki Pauli jwajenda pamu na twepani kunndamuki Yakobu, na aseja boti babandu ba bunhobale Kilisitu babii pala.
Pajwajomula kwaalamuki, Pauli jwaapwagila majambu goha gajwatenda Sapanga pabandu ba ndema jeyengi kupetee lihengu lakii.
Pabajogwana haga, bunndumbalia Sapanga. Ndi bumpwagila Pauli, “Nndongu wito, ubweni Ayaudi bingi haba babung'alambuki Kilisitu na boti abi na wipu na malagalaki gaka Sapanga.
Ajogwini hegwaabola kila lisoba Ayaudi baatama pikilanda ja bandu banga Ayaudi biipwata malagalaki gaka Musa kwa kaapwagi biiseku banababu jandu wala kupwata mahengu gaayobali Ayaudi.
Henu tutenda boo? Ndaba biijogwana gubii pamba pa Yelusalemu.
Henu utenda letukupwagi. Tubi na bandu nsesi paamba baabi na nazili kwaka Sapanga.

Ajukua bandu haba, gubiya nabu pamu pa tipati gukulinyambisa na kwaagalami ili amoga majunzu giimutu yabu. Ndi bandu boha biimanya majambu gabajogwana nga ga sakaka, hata wamwe ugajetaki malagalaki gaka Musa.

Lakini kupete bandu banga Ayaudi babuhobale Sapanga, twapelaki balua kwapwagi majambu ga tuamwi. Biikula sokapi seatendi matambiku gaka sapanga biisoli, biikunywa mwai, biikula inyama ikinyama seakinyongiki, ajepana nukugone na bandu bila ndoa.”

Ndienu, kilabu jaki Pauli jwaajukua bandu bala jwatenda ndumbali jukulinyambisa pamu nabombi. Ndienu jwajingala mu Nyumba jaka Sapanga kupwaga lisoba laki la mwisu lukulinyambisa na matambiku gabu gajwiboa kwa kila jumu wabu.
Pauli bunkamu mu Nyumba jaka Sapanga
Masoba saba gala hegahegali kujomoka, Ayaudi bababi ahumiki ku nkoa uku Asia bumbona Pauli mu Nyumba jaka Sapanga. Bakwelakiya bandu ayoma nukunkamu Pauli.

Bajamaliya, “Mwabandu buku Isilaeli, mutujangatiaje! Jonzo ndi mundu jojwabola bandu kila pandu majambu gagaapenga bandu buku Isilaeli, gagapenga malagalaki gaka Musa na Nyumba jaka Sapanga jenzeno. Hata heno jwajingisi mombo bandu bukuhuma ndema jengi nuku pajege upija pandu pasapi pamba.”
Bapwaaga hela ndaba babi ambweni Tilofimo, mundu juku Epesu, jubi pamu na Pauli pababi kumusi, bawasaliya Pauli joanzingisi mu Nyumba jaka Sapanga.
Musi woka wabi na puju, bandu bahika kuhuma pandi yoka, bunkamula Pauli nukunkangakanga, numkumpia kunza ja Nyumba jaka Sapanga apalapa nukupunga milyangu.
Pabapala kunkoma, lijambu lela lahika kwaka nkolongu wa jwaalonda juku Loma kuba musi uku Yelusalemu woka watweli puju.
Apalapa, nkolongu jwaalonda jwaleta alonda na akilongosi bangi, bajombatakiya pa puju pala jebatenda nsambi wa bandu. Nabombi pabumbona nkolongu wa alonda jola na alonda baki, bakotuka kundapu Pauli.
Nkolongu wa alonda anzendila Pauli, ankamula nukulagalaki bunkonga minyolu mibeli. Ndienu jwalalukiya, “Jonioju we nyanye, kabee jutei bole?”

Bangi mu nsambi wa bandu gola babia apwaga ale na bandu bangi bapwaga ale. Ndaba ja puju jela, nkolongu wa alonda jola ngasejwawesiki kumanya sekipiti. Ndienu jalagalakiya alonda baki bumpelika Pauli nkati ja nyumba ja alonda.
Pauli pajwahika pa ngasi, alonda kwapalika buntotula ndaba bandu bajonzukiya puju.
Nsambi nkolongu wa bandu bumpwata koni atenda kujamali kwa sauti, “Unkomila ako!”
Pauli jutenda kulingengalela
Pabunzingia mu nyumba ja alonda, Pauli andoba nkolongu wa alonda jwapwaga, “Nhwesale kukupwagi sindo?” Nkolongu wa alonda jola jwapwaga, “Boo uwesa lee kulonge Kigiliki?
Weapa ngalee mundu juku Misili jola jojwatumbuliya jojahenga bandu ang'anambuka malagalaki kwisukwisu apa na kwaalongo bandu elupu nnsesi agaide bala mbaka ku kulungwenza?”
Pauli jajibua, “Nepani nu Nhyahude, nihumi ku Musi uku Taliso nndema uku Kilikia, nena mundu wa musi nkolongo. Gupepakoku, nanonge na bando.”
Nkolongu waalonda jola andeka julongila. Ndienu Pauli jwajema pikikwelu, jwaapongila bandu bala kuboku. Hebatama kinunu, jwalongila nabu kupete luga ji Kiebulania.
